podcast.body: The Trinidad Singers provided backing vocals for Murray Head on the single "Superstar," released in the fall of 1969. This song, connected to the *Jesus Christ Superstar* musical, reached the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1970. "Superstar by Murray Head and the Trinidad Singers, which was released in the fall of 1969."
